reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issueTitle 'Vim mode: JSON key config (mise-darwin compatible), helix/which-key next-key hints, and hop/easymotion jumps' (no GitHub issue number); workflow opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-395; intake comm-007071, design review comm-007073 (DR-K1 repaired), design accepted comm-007075, plan review comm-007077, plan repair comm-007078, plans accepted comm-007079
reviewContext.userProblem: The user wants the vactr code pane Vim key config to be specifiable in JSON and configurable like their Neovim setup in /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/mise-darwin, with helix/which-key style next-key candidates at the bottom left after a prefix key, and hop/easymotion jumps on gj/gf that can be switched on or off in the config.
requiredOutcomes: Versioned JSON keymap document (schema version 1): leader, timeoutlen, per-mode maps (n, i, x/v, o, c) in Vim notation, rhs as a noremap/remap key sequence or a named action id, <Nop>, desc; per-entry validation that reports and skips invalid entries and never stops the editor from starting (design 2, 3, 4)

Web storage in localStorage key vactr.vimKeymap and Tauri storage in vim-keymap.json in the app config directory via vim_keymap_get/set/reset; JSON import/export; a flat, square in-editor settings panel; live apply without reload (design 8)
Bundled Default and mise-darwin presets; mise-darwin reproduces the reference mappings, with unsupported entries documented (design 9)
Extended built-ins needed by the preset: gk gj gJ g; g, zz <C-e> <C-y> and minimal surround ys/cs/ds (design 5)

Next-key hint panel at the bottom left after the triggers <Space> g m z, with delayMs (default 200 ms), descriptions, multi-level prefixes and aria-live; it does not steal focus or break IME (design 6)

hop.char1 (gj), hop.char1Line (gf), hop.word and hop.line in normal and visual mode, with labels from hop.keys drawn through a narrow renderer overlay hook; hop.enabled off makes the mappings inert and removes them from the hints (design 7)
Invariant K0: with no stored document, behavior is exactly the merged Vim mode (design 1)
Unit, InputController integration and Playwright e2e coverage (kj escape, <Space> hint content, gj hop jump, hop off); README and the vim design doc updated (design 11)
nonGoals: No new npm or cargo dependencies and no Tauri capability changes
No code copied from hop.nvim, mini.clue, which-key or vim-surround
No soft wrap; gj/gk are plain line motions (D2)
No tag or function surrounds and no visual S (D3)
File write/quit, LSP restart, QuickRun, Chilla and telescope mappings have no vactr meaning; they map to the nearest vactr action or are listed as unsupported
constraints: Work only in this worktree on wf/vim-keymap; never touch other worktrees or main; never kill processes you did not start
AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, no tool attribution in commits; every touched source file stays under 1000 lines (controller.ts <= 850 lines, keymap-runtime.ts <= 300 lines)
UI is solid, flat and square (border-radius 0), spaced, never a native widget look; npm run test:style must pass
EditorState is the single document authority; the renderer change is limited to the hop overlay hook; insert-mode Japanese IME is unchanged and normal-mode IME never inserts text
Heavy suites (full vitest, Playwright) run under the measurement lock /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr-worktrees/.measure-lock
Run VACTR_REQUIRE_SESSION_ABI=1 npm run build immediately before any npm run e2e

Each plan declares artifactRoots and edits only its writePaths and its sharedPaths with the recorded intended edits; each plan owns its Progress Log; commit and push happen only in serial finalization
Verification records use {command, exitStatus: 0, testsRun, testsPassed, failureCount: 0, outcome: passed, log, notes}; negative controls go in mutationEvidence
designDecisionsAndRationale: A pure mapping layer (mapper.ts) in front of CommandParser. Leftover and remapped keys re-enter through sink.route, so pass-through and mode routing stay correct (DR-K1)
Action ids only for features without Vim keys (vactr.*, hop.*); Vim motions, registers and ex commands are reached through noremap rhs sequences (D1)
Extended built-ins turn on whenever a document is stored, so K0 parity is preserved without one (KQ6)
Hints and hop are off without a stored document; the mise-darwin preset turns them on (KQ1)
Tauri storage follows the existing default-template command pattern with atomic writes and size/version validation, with no capability change
Hop labels go through optional RenderFeedback.hopLabels/hopRevision rather than glyph geometry changes
Insert-mode multi-key maps such as kj defer the first key, as Vim does (KQ3)
intentionalTradeoffs: The hint panel suspends timeoutlen while it is visible (D6)
Under the mise-darwin preset, a single <Esc> in normal mode and a single k in visual or insert mode wait up to timeoutlen (Neovim-equivalent)
Hop smartcase, label order and the prefix-free labels are this design's own (D7, KQ4)
Hop label quad width uses a fixed 8px advance (VKPR-L1, low residual risk)
Insert <C-v> paste from + is listed as unsupported in the preset; Mod-v pastes (KQ7)
P keys can never be remapped; <C-y> scroll is reachable only from an rhs (D4)
supportedEdgeCases: Invalid JSON or a missing version 1 falls back to K0
Invalid entries are reported with path-qualified messages and skipped
Multi-character hop labels when targets outnumber hop.keys; 4,096 target cap
Hop in visual mode extends the selection; hop as an operator target when mapped in o mode (KQ5)
kj typed through an active IME stays IME input (D5)
Blur and focusout clear pending mapping, hint and hop state
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Linewise surround beyond one charwise span, tag surrounds and visual S
Visual block mode (deferred in the baseline VQ1)
Preset entries the reference dotfiles cannot supply; they fall back to the design 9.2 table and the gap is recorded (KQ2)
